subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the face having the number '3'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fcf7be59390904393d8ece775c19389e0155e2dd7b61c74ff4cc12723e9b5ca.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

 
• As 2 and 4 are common on first and the second dice, it is clear that 3 is opposite to 6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6466ee93df747f64b296083d97d09e811948c008b27095a569229016ff90cc1.png] 

 
• As 2 and 3 are common on first and the third dice, it is clear that 4 is opposite to 1.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f78a2869f57d03057e7f1086a1b3e09c73cf34bc8984e5e40e3ebbbfc48c91d.png] 

Opposite pairs:

3 → 6

4 → 1

2 → 5 (Left out numbers)

So, the opposite side of "3" will be side "6".

Hence, the correct answer is "6".
